episodes.title: Peace and War
episodes.summary: Flight commander Ajay Ahuja is called in to train the Golden Arrows. As the Indo-Pak peace talks begin, General Musharraf considers his next move.

episodes.title: Sada-e-Sarhad
episodes.summary: Baldy struggles to get his head in the game, but a unique bonding exercise brings the squad together. As they celebrate, trouble looms in the mountains.

episodes.title: Safed Sagar
episodes.summary: General Musharraf and the prime minister lock horns. The Golden Arrows race to uncover the infiltrators, but a shocking incident jolts the squadron.

episodes.title: Golden Arrows
episodes.summary: Panic grips the Indian forces as the Kargil War quickly escalates and Ahuja is pulled into peril. Amid nationwide outrage, a plan to fight back emerges.

episodes.title: Bombs Away
episodes.summary: A high-altitude bombing strategy brings new challenges for the Golden Arrows. As Dhali grapples with guilt, General Musharraf's plans begin to unravel.

episodes.title: Line of Control
episodes.summary: As international pressure mounts, a bold formation tactic could signal a momentous shift as the war reaches a turning point.
